label: SCG I.22 finite conjunction interpretations
meaning: The signature has a nonvacuous positive assignment and distinct omission assignments for each source/analyst bridge, self-esse identification, and necessity of the esse; a stable necessary joining of distinct principles is compatible with the encoded first-case bundle of n.4, relative to the modal proxy for n.3's non-necessary conjunction; n.4's second case is not encoded.
